content.title: Eid Mubarak
content.text: As'salamu Alykum, Muslim Association of Virginia (MAV Inc.) wishes everyone peace and blessings. Eid Mubarak to our brothers and sisters of all faiths. With the blessings of Allah (SWT) we will celebrate Eid ul-Adha on Tuesday 08/21/2018. Eid Prayers at Dar Alnoor Islamic Community Center 5404 Hoadly Rd, Manassas, VA 20112 7:00AM, 8:30AM, 9:45AM, 10:45AM PARKING ALERT Please visit our website www.daralnoor.org for details on parking; click here for map showing parking locations and shuttle route Eid Prayer at Veterans Park 14300 Veterans Dr, Woodbridge, VA 22191 8:30 AM Please DO NOT Bring Used Clothes Thank you for your good intentions to bring used clothing to the Masjid. We are only able to accept clothe donations during special drives. Other than that, we are not able to accept clothe donation as we have no where to store them or a system to distribute them. Please stop. Please take your used items to the Muslim operated FAITH social services - 795 Center Street, Herndon, VA 20170. Local drop offs: ACTS thrift store- 3661 Canal Road, Dumfries, VA 22026. The Goodwill at 2950 Dale Boulevard, Dale City. IAMAV Sunday School - Fall 2018 Semster Register today to get the early discounted rate of $209 per student for the entire Fall 2018 semester! **** Last day to register to get discounted rate: August 25, 2018 **** Weeknight Qur'an and Arabic Program at Dar al Noor Learn how to read, write, recite and memorize Qur'an (with proper tajweed). Qur'anic Arabic School (QAS). Fee: $60 per month per student Age group: 5 and up (Boys and Girls, youth, adolescents and adults) Days: Monday through Thursday Time: 6:00pm - 7:30pm Jummah Congregational Prayers Dar al Noor Islamic Community Center 5404 Hoadly Rd, Manassas, VA 20112 12:30 PM - Brother Tayeb Farighi 01:45 PM - Brother Abdul Mannan Kaisken 02:45 PM - Brother Imran Azimi Dar as Salaam (MAV - Woodbridge) 14300 Veterans Dr, Woodbridge, VA 22191 01:00PM - Dr. Nabil Samman Potomac Hospital 2300 Opitz Blvd, Woodbridge, VA 22191 01:30PM - Brother Iqramul Islam Friday Prayers at Potomac Hospital are held at 1:30 P.M. in the "Worship Room." We need volunteers to set up the room before and after the prayer. Quantico Islamic Prayer Center, Quantico Marine Base Chapel Annex Building, 3019 Embry Loop, Quantico, VA 22134 1:15 PM All that is required to drive to and from the chapel on base is valid driver's license, car registration, proof of insurance and obeying the speed limits.
